import os, sys, json, hashlib, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path
BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = Path('/home/name/Documents/420-EMBDX/A')
ROOT = BASE / 'candidate'
LEDGER = BASE / 'execution.json'
LOG = BASE / 'execution.log'
ENV = {'PATH': '/home/name/.local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin', 'LC_ALL': 'C',
       'HOME': str(BASE), 'TERM': 'ansi', 'TMPDIR': str(BASE / 'tmp-candidate')}
Path(ENV['TMPDIR']).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def run(label, argv, cwd=ROOT, expected=0, env=None, timeout=300):
    start = time.monotonic()
    p = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, env=ENV if env is None else env,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                       timeout=timeout)
    entry = {'label': label, 'argv': argv, 'cwd': str(cwd),
             'status': p.returncode, 'expected': expected,
             'seconds': round(time.monotonic()-start, 3),
             'stdout_sha256': hashlib.sha256(p.stdout).hexdigest(),
             'stderr_sha256': hashlib.sha256(p.stderr).hexdigest()}
    entries = json.loads(LEDGER.read_text()) if LEDGER.exists() else []
    entries.append(entry); LEDGER.write_text(json.dumps(entries, indent=2)+'\n')
    with LOG.open('ab') as f:
        f.write(('\n### '+json.dumps(entry)+'\nSTDOUT\n').encode())
        f.write(p.stdout); f.write(b'\nSTDERR\n'); f.write(p.stderr)
        f.write(b'\nEND\n')
    print(label, p.returncode, 'expected', expected, flush=True)
    if p.returncode != expected:
        print(p.stdout[-5000:].decode(errors='backslashreplace'))
        print(p.stderr[-5000:].decode(errors='backslashreplace'))
    return p
if __name__ == '__main__':
    run(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:])
